nodes.label: Core loop: POIs -> resources -> soldiers -> capture POIs
nodes.norm_label: core loop: pois -> resources -> soldiers -> capture pois
nodes.rationale: Factions grow armies from territory so players face escalating enemies as they grow.

nodes.label: Daily tick with /time edge cases
nodes.rationale: Step lands at start of each day crossed; /time set backwards resets lastProcessedDay so no day is paid twice.

nodes.label: Determinism rules
nodes.rationale: Radius/strength from seed+position hash, never random rolls; settings frozen at world creation so config edits only affect new worlds.

nodes.label: Distance scaling of Empire strength and radius
nodes.norm_label: distance scaling of empire strength and radius

nodes.label: Economy loop (produce, upkeep, decide, resolve)
nodes.rationale: Unowned POIs produce nothing, giving factions a reason to expand.

nodes.label: Empire
nodes.rationale: Originates from a very rare Capital; claim radius 1-10 steps of 1,000 blocks; only type that claims POIs.

nodes.label: Faction types (Empire, City-state, Bandit)
nodes.rationale: Type fixed by origin structure so it never depends on chunk load order.

nodes.label: Hurricane world layout
nodes.rationale: Calm eye at spawn, war zone of medium powers, stronger empires farther out: difficulty scales with travel.

nodes.label: Milestone 1: one Empire earning food from Farms
nodes.norm_label: milestone 1: one empire earning food from farms

nodes.label: Offline catch-up gamerule PassIngameTimeForIRLTime
nodes.rationale: Off by default; 1 real hour = 3 days, capped, max 50 days per tick so a backlog never freezes the server.

nodes.label: Open questions (R1/R2, thresholds, capture rules, resources, off-player battles)
nodes.norm_label: open questions (r1/r2, thresholds, capture rules, resources, off-player battles)

nodes.label: POI ownership rule (highest strength, nearest Capital, position hash)
nodes.norm_label: poi ownership rule (highest strength, nearest capital, position hash)
nodes.rationale: Ownership frozen at first compute; only battles change it.

nodes.label: Design pillars: data-simulated factions, baked-in POIs, seed determinism
nodes.norm_label: design pillars: data-simulated factions, baked-in pois, seed determinism
nodes.rationale: Factions simulated as data rather than live mobs keeps cost low; POIs baked into worldgen; generation deterministic from seed.

nodes.label: Placeholder structures (fenced wheat Farm, stone keep Capital)
nodes.norm_label: placeholder structures (fenced wheat farm, stone keep capital)

nodes.label: Project setup (Forge 1.20.1, mod ID rafasconquest, Recruits via Modrinth maven)
nodes.norm_label: project setup (forge 1.20.1, mod id rafasconquest, recruits via modrinth maven)

nodes.label: RecruitsBridge interface
nodes.rationale: All future Recruits API contact sits behind one interface; Milestone 1 must not call it.

nodes.label: rafasconquest_world SavedData
nodes.rationale: Single overworld SavedData; every field must round-trip through NBT identically.

nodes.label: Milestone 1 scope fence
nodes.rationale: No battles, spawning, captures, raids, City-state/Bandit origins or non-food resources; leave extension points only.

nodes.norm_label: storm wall (r1 to r2) capital ring

nodes.label: Strength as soldier pool (300-5,000 at gen, max 400,000)
nodes.norm_label: strength as soldier pool (300-5,000 at gen, max 400,000)
nodes.rationale: 1 strength = 1 recruit soldier; battle losses remove from the pool.

nodes.label: Technical architecture components
nodes.rationale: Faction state lives in world save data; real entities spawn only near players.

nodes.label: Threading rule: worldgen never writes save data
nodes.norm_label: threading rule: worldgen never writes save data
nodes.rationale: Chunk generation runs off-thread; updates are queued to the server thread.

nodes.label: Virtual POIs (precomputed placement)
nodes.rationale: Placement is deterministic from the seed like /locate, so factions earn from POIs before chunks exist.
